name: When should I consider replacing my bathroom sink?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider replacing my bathroom sink?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider replacing your bathroom sink if it's visibly cracked, stained beyond cleaning, or experiencing persistent leaks that repairs can't fix. Upgrading your sink is also a good idea during a bathroom renovation to improve aesthetics or functionality. For instance, if you're upgrading to a modern vanity, a compatible new sink will ensure a cohesive look and optimal use of space. Our team can assess the condition and help you decide.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replace your sink if it's damaged, leaking, or during a bathroom renovation to update aesthetics or improve functionality.
